description: Cross-market holidays, limited sessions, DST and research events, with independently recorded Cboe spot VIX sessions through 2027-03-31.

winter_standard.notes: Winter 02:30 BJT COMEX official settlement coincides identically with SHFE/SGE 02:30 night session close, enabling exact same-minute domestic premium calculation.

summer_dst.notes: From 2027-03-14 onward, all US market closes and COMEX settlement shift 1 hour earlier in BJT; UK/LBMA shifts 1 hour earlier on 2027-03-28.

overlay_mode_rules.A: 美盘休市或提前收盘：美股/美债/CFTC 明标休市或推迟、沿用上一 NY 终盘（标精确时点），聚焦伦敦/上金所/上期所实盘与节假薄量防插针。
overlay_mode_rules.B: 中国内地休市：A 股、上金所（SGE）、上期所（SHFE）及在岸人民币明标休市且严禁编造内盘新价，聚焦 COMEX/伦敦现货/离岸 CNH 与海外 ETF。
overlay_mode_rules.C: 欧/英/日/港/印单边休市或半日市：局部标注休市市场与恢复时刻，其余正常市场按标准流程编译。
overlay_mode_rules.GLOBAL: 全球主要金融市场同步休市：自动切入周末/节假日专项版，严禁伪造盘口，聚焦 7x24 链上黄金（XAUT/PAXG）、BTC、线下客流与中长期专题。
